description: Long-term Electricity Demand Forecasting using THI-ConvNet is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Giwman Bak, Youngchul Bae (Chonnam National University - Yeosu Campus). Electricity load forecasting helps plan for the stability and efficiency of power supply systems, particularly during holidays when demand patterns tend to deviate from normal trends. However, most existing studies focus on short-term forecasts and lack the capability to effectively incorporate the irregularities caused by long-term holidays. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
